questions.q: PopDEX is a perpetual futures (perp) DEX.
questions.note: PopDEX is a trader-first Perp DEX focused on capital efficiency and trading experience

questions.q: Which blockchain is PopDEX built on?
questions.note: PopDEX is a decentralized perpetual exchange built on Morph Tachyon

questions.q: How much of the value PopDEX creates goes back to real contributors?
questions.note: returning 100% of the value it creates to real contributors

questions.q: PopDEX lets you trade from one unified margin account across markets.
questions.note: One unified margin account turns your entire portfolio into collateral—cross-market, cross-asset

questions.q: What kind of order book does PopDEX use?
questions.note: PopDEX uses a fully on-chain central limit order book

questions.q: When does the weekly MegaPop Pop Draw happen?
questions.note: The Pop Draw takes place every Monday at 3:00 AM UTC.

questions.q: The winning Pop Hash is generated from which blockchain?
questions.note: the winning 6-digit number, called the Pop Hash, is generated using the Bitcoin blockchain

questions.q: How is the Pop Hash taken from the chosen Bitcoin block hash?
questions.note: MegaPop extracts the last 6 numeric digits from the selected Bitcoin block hash to generate the Pop Hash

questions.q: A Pop Ticket digit only counts as a match if both the digit and its position match.
questions.note: a digit only counts as a match if both the digit and its position are the same

questions.q: Which prize do you win by matching all 6 digits of the Pop Hash?
questions.note: 6 | Mega Prize | 42% of the current prize pool

questions.q: What share of the current MegaPop Pool goes to the Mega Prize?
questions.note: Mega Prize receives 42% of the current MegaPop Pool.

questions.q: What is the fixed reward for matching 4 digits (3rd Prize)?
questions.note: 4 | 3rd Prize | 100 USDT

questions.q: What is the max number of Pop Tickets one address can get per weekly draw cycle?
questions.note: Each address can receive up to 10,000 Pop Tickets per weekly draw cycle.

questions.q: What share of net protocol trading fees is allocated to the MegaPop Pool?
questions.note: 40% of net protocol trading fees are allocated to the MegaPop Pool, while 60% supports Referral, Affiliate, and ecosystem campaigns

questions.q: Wash trading and self-trading earn Pop Tickets.
questions.note: Wash trading, self-trading, and bonus-only or zero-fee activity do not [count towards tickets]

questions.q: Which PopDEX pair tracks Gold?
questions.note: XAUUSDT | Gold | 20x | London (XAGUSDT = Silver, CLUSDT = WTI Crude, BZUSDT = Brent)

questions.q: What is the max leverage on PopDEX's Gold (XAUUSDT) perp?
questions.note: XAUUSDT | Gold | 20x

questions.q: PopDEX crypto perpetual futures are margined in which asset?
questions.note: PopDEX offers USDT-margined linear perpetual futures on crypto assets.

questions.q: What decides your PopDEX VIP fee tier?
questions.note: VIP tiers are based on each account's 14-day rolling trading volume on PopDEX.

questions.q: Which firm audited PopDEX's smart contracts?
questions.note: PopDEX smart contracts are audited by BlockSec
